Early Advantage for the Gunners On July 26, 2026 , the match ignited quickly as Arsenal found their rhythm within the opening minutes. In the 6th minute, Kai Havertz pounced on a defensive lapse by Marquinhos , clinicaly finishing with his left foot to give the London side an early lead. The first half was a display of Arsenal's discipline, as they successfully neutralized the creative threats of Paris Saint-Germain , though Ousmane Dembélé remained a constant menace with his delivery from wide areas and set pieces. PSG Fight Back The narrative shifted in the second half as PSG increased their intensity. The pressure reached a breaking point in the 62nd minute when Khvicha Kvaratskhelia was brought down in the box by Cristhian Mosquera . After a tense VAR review, the referee pointed to the spot, and Ousmane Dembélé coolly converted the penalty, sending David Raya the wrong way. The match became increasingly physical, with Bukayo Saka and Mosquera both receiving yellow cards as both teams struggled to find a decisive second goal before the end of regulation time. Penalty Heartbreak and Triumph Extra time was a grueling affair characterized by tactical substitutions, including the introduction of Viktor Gyökeres and Martin Zubimendi for Arsenal , and Lucas Beraldo for PSG . Tensions boiled over on the sidelines, with Mikel Arteta and Declan Rice cautioned for dissent. Ultimately, the match was decided by a shootout. Despite conversions from Martinelli and Rice , misses by Eberechi Eze and Gabriel proved costly for the Gunners. Paris Saint-Germain remained composed, with Lucas Beraldo slotting home the final penalty to secure a hard-fought victory for the Parisians.

matches.description: Watch Real Madrid vs WSG Swarovski Tirol highlights and goals from Friendly on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on July 26, 2026. Real Madrid and Athletic Club faced off in a high-octane encounter that showcased tactical discipline and clinical attacking prowess. Fans were treated to a summer spectacle filled with technical brilliance and a relentless pursuit of goals from both sides. First-Half Flare-up and Volleyed Goals On July 26, 2026 , Real Madrid signaled their intent early, dominating possession and pinning Athletic Club back. The deadlock was broken in the 12th minute when Daniel Carvajal found Gonzalo Garcia , who composedly finished with his right foot. While the Basque side looked to find their footing, Madrid’s midfield engine kept the pressure high, eventually leading to a second goal in the 41st minute. Thiago Pitarch turned provider, lofting a ball for Jude Bellingham , who unleashed a sensational left-footed volley into the back of the net. However, Athletic Club refused to go into the break quietly. In the first minute of stoppage time, Inaki Williams delivered a pinpoint cross for Gorka Guruzeta , who mirrored Bellingham’s earlier effort with a stunning volley of his own. The goal halved the deficit and injected a surge of energy into the match just before the halftime whistle blew. Mbappé Magic and VAR Confirmation The second half began with a moment of pure class from Kylian Mbappé . In the 51st minute, the French forward received a pass from Alvaro Carreras and unleashed a powerful strike from outside the box that left the goalkeeper stranded. Real Madrid continued to dictate the tempo, maintaining 74% possession and creating numerous chances, though several offside calls against Mbappé and Pitarch kept the scoreline from swelling further. As the clock ticked toward full-time, the drama intensified. In the 88th minute, Brahim Diaz found the net, but the celebrations were momentarily halted for a VAR review. After a tense wait, the referee overturned the initial decision and awarded the goal to the home side. Athletic Club managed a late response in the 91st minute when Urko Izeta headed home from another Inaki Williams assist, but it was merely a consolation as Real Madrid secured a dominant victory.
